# Engineering Delivery Review
Review goals, work breakdown, dependencies, team availability, integration critical path and unknowns. Build assumption register, delivery scenarios, risk register, milestone exit criteria and decision asks. Keep planning forecasts distinct from approved commitments.

## Output
State observations, evidence, assumptions, prioritized actions, validation and human approval points. Do not claim actions or tests were completed unless tools actually ran.
